name: lucky-doctor
title_zh: 药盒拍一下，新药和老药冲不冲它先拦
tagline_zh: 吃药最怕重复吃、冲突吃。拍药盒或说明书，它比对你的用药史，拦下重复成分和相互作用，还能把用法生成语音包，给老人听。
tagline_en: Worried about double dosing or drug clashes? Snap any med box or leaflet—it cross-checks your history, flags.
desc_en: Use when the user wants to identify medicine boxes, drug instruction leaflets, pharmaceutical packaging, or medication labels. Also use as a personal drug assistant: check new medicines against the user's history for duplicate medication or drug interactions, manage (add/list/update/delete) the user's medicine records, generate voice broadcast for medicine instructions, create medicine audio packa
why_zh: 不是查单盒说明书，而是拿新药撞你的旧药单——重复成分、相互作用在入口就拦下。
why_en: It doesn't just read one leaflet—it slams the new med against your existing list, catching overlaps and interactions before you.
limit_zh: 只认药盒/说明书上的文字，拍不清或非标准药名就识别不了；语音包是合成朗读，不含医生诊断；不替代急诊。
limit_en: Needs legible text on box/leaflet; non-standard names fail. Voice is TTS only, no diagnosis. Not for emergencies—call 120 if overdose suspected.
title_en: Snap a med box, it checks clashes with your history
